features: 【Crystal-Clear 4K Video & 16MP Photo Quality】 Capture every moment in breathtaking 4K resolution at 30FPS, complemented by stunning 16MP photos. The 170° ultra-wide-angle lens ensures you never miss a detail, while compression delivers smooth, high-quality playback. Supports Micro SD cards up to 64GB (NOT INCLUDED), ensuring you have plenty of storage for all your adventures.

【Professional Elevea 4K Action Camera】The sport camera provides professional 4k/30fps video, up to 30 frames per second and 16MP photos, capture and share your world in an amazing resolution. The built-in anti-shake function and equipped with 6 layers of optical glass lenses can effectively eliminate vibration, and at the same time, it can bring you vivid and realistic images to ensure that pictures and videos are more clear and smooth.

【Multifunctional】Action camera 4k supports an external 2.5mm microphone(not included) and adjust the view angle of this sports camera according to your needs between wide(170°), medium, and narrow, to capture crisp directional sounds, providing ultra convenience for hiking, cycling, skiing, etc. And sport camera comes with rechargeable batteries, you will no longer worry about the recording time for this action camera.

【30m Waterproof】With the durable waterproof case, you can take the camera dive into water up to 30m, perfect for water sports such as swimming, driving, surfing etc. And helmet camera uses technology to minimize camera shake and blurring while moving. It can easily take crystal clear stable images even at high speed or other extreme sports conditions. Comes with tons of free accessories, you can transform it to fit various extreme activities.
